problem: Fresh chat/file isolation cannot prove the model lacks pretrained or parametric knowledge of already-broadcast target episodes.
timing: Run PM0 recall probes before any C/T candidate generation. Seal all PM0 outputs before C/T. Do not reveal PM0 outputs to C/T generators.

per_work_probe.provider_class: same real-provider model/config class used for C/T
input_only: instruction to report only specific target-episode facts already remembered without web/tools/files; UNKNOWN is explicitly allowed

custody: Hash-seal three PM0 outputs per selected work before C/T starts. Coordinator stores them unread where feasible; in all cases candidate generators never receive them.

inputs: Past-Only cutoff material needed only to judge whether a claim was already inferable from past episodes
adjudication_after_human_reveal.confirmed_claim_rule: >=2/3 judges label the same substantive claim EXACT_TARGET_FACT
adjudication_after_human_reveal.contamination_positive_rule: >=2 confirmed target-specific claims that are not generic/cutoff-inferable
adjudication_after_human_reveal.consequence: If positive, that work cannot support the primary prospective C/T/H claim. Preserve all outputs as secondary contaminated evidence; use the next preregistered hash-ranked eligible replacement if continuing the primary benchmark.

no_posthoc_rule: Thresholds and consequence may not change after first PM0 output.
claim_boundary: PM0 is a contamination diagnostic, not a literary-quality score.
